svg.text: CATHODE FLANGE (Деталь 3 · Zone 3)
Capsule-side anchor end · pogo face + bayonet · 01_01 §1 · 02_02 §1.2
FRONT (pogo face)
Ø4.5 GND pad
iso ring ≥1.5 REQUIRED · NOT IN GEOMETRY
3× bayonet lug
O-ring groove Ø20.8/Ø16.17 × 1.34 deep (face seal, 02_02 §3.2)
groove 1.34 deep × 2.31 wide (derived, notes 5)
SIDE (section)
Ø9
NOTES:
1. Cathode catalytic = side/perimeter (O₂ under radome); pogo = top face (02_02 §1.2)
2. Material: Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5)
3. Process: SLM/DMLS or EBM. The 'precision less critical' allowance of 01_02 1.7 applies to the FLANGE DISC only (flat O25 face, roughness = ECSA
advantage) — it does NOT extend to the bus channel, which is the part's primary datum and is machined after printing (see post-process). Reading it
part-wide licenses an as-printed bore and contradicts note 5. HIP is OPTIONAL on this part and that is a CANON CLAUSE, not an omission (01_02 1.7
conclusion table): Zone 1, the gyroid anode, carries a MANDATORY HIP; this Zone-3 flange does not, and the stated ground is that an EBM hot build
platform relieves the residual stress HIP exists to remove. ATTENTION - that ground covers the EBM branch only, and canon does not say what follows if
you print this part on a laser machine. So state which process you would use and whether you HIP it; we are ASKING here, not specifying, and silence is
not consent either way (00_07 HW.23).
4. Surface: PER-SURFACE, not one finish for the whole part (01_02 1.3): catalytic side/perimeter = EAAE dual-scale micro Sa 0.5-5 um + nano Sv 50-500 nm
(Step 4, Laccase/ZIF ECSA) - NO PEP and NO H2O2 passivation on that face (Steps 6-7); outer jacket = PEP smoothing to Ra 0.4 um max (Step 7) before
ZnO-Ta PEO; pogo top face = MASKED during EAAE, then SELECTIVE Hard-Gold ENIG on the central GND pad + outer pogo ring only, the PEEK isolation ring
02_02 1.2 requires between them is NOT in this geometry (solid Ti top face; open, 00_07 HW.34). Sand-blasting is admissible on THIS part (Zone 3,
line-of-sight geometry, Step 3), unlike the Zone-1 gyroid.
5. Post-process: selective Hard-Gold ENIG on central GND pad + outer pogo ring (02_02 1.2, Ti-Au galvanic-trap fix); build tip-down (01_01 4.3 A: the barbs
self-support on this SEPARATE print) - which leaves the O25 disc above the O9 shank as a flat down-facing overhang needing supports; which face they
land on, and whether that face is functional, is open (00_07 HW.26) | bus channel O1.35: MACHINE after printing to the tolerance block (primary datum,
0.05 concentricity/runout) - NOT as-printed. The nominal was OPENED 1.30 -> 1.35 by verdict (00_07 HW.34, 2026-09-11) so the rod+liner stack (1.0 +
2x0.15 = 1.30) enters with a real 50 um diametral clearance instead of the zero the arithmetic used to allow; the change rides this EXISTING machining
operation, it does not add one. ATTENTION - the DIAMETRAL TOLERANCE BAND on this bore is NOT SPECIFIED anywhere in canon and is not derivable: 50 um may
fall inside the tolerance of the extruded PEEK tube itself, whose supplier holds ID/OD and not the wall we froze. It is a question to the vendor (00_07
HW.34), so quote your achievable band rather than reading a default into the blank | bus channel ENTRY EDGE (the shank end face, opposite the flange
face, where the liner-covered bus rod enters): a RADIUS, NOT a chamfer. The rod reaches that mouth at a shallow angle, far below a lead-in chamfer's
30-45 deg, so it never lands on a chamfer - it bears on the line where the chamfer meets the bore; a chamfer only moves that edge, a radius removes it.
RADIUS VALUE: NOT SPECIFIED IN CEM - choosing one needs a contact model that does not exist yet (00_07 HW.34), so state the edge radius you can produce
at the entry of this channel and how you verify it; a sharp or chamfered edge is not a reading of this blank | O-RING GROOVE on the top (pogo) face -
the ONE face seal of the capsule (02_02 3.2 / 3.5, 00_07 HW.33 branch (a), applied 2026-09-14): MACHINE after printing. Depth 1.344 = CS 1.78 x (1 -
0.245 ratified squeeze); width 2.315 = ring section 2.489 mm2 / (0.80 gland fill x depth); cut between r 8.085 and r 10.4, i.e. inside the radome's seal
land (r 7.785-10.7) with 0.3 of land on each side. All of these are DERIVED from the o_ring block, none is typed. The radome rim is FLAT and lands on
this face as the seal datum, so the squeeze is this depth ALONE. DEPTH TOLERANCE: NOT SPECIFIED IN CEM - the whole O-ring chain (this depth + the
flatness of this face + the flatness of the radome rim, RSS) must stay within +/-98 um, so the question to you is 'can you hold +/-0.05 on this depth',
never a general-tolerance grade (00_07 HW.33). ATTENTION: the gland fill 80 % is an OPEN verdict - the WIDTH moves with it (85 % -> 2.178, 90 % ->
2.057), the depth does not
6. Coating: Catalytic face (Laccase + ZIF-nanozyme + PTFE-GDL): ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic (Zn-HAp/chitosan) ALL FORBIDDEN - bare Ti only,
any dielectric blocks DET. Outer jacket: ZnO-Ta + 8-HQ allowed. NOT on PEEK. (01_02 3.6)
7. Lattice: Not applicable - solid flange disc with a central bus channel, no lattice. (The lattice lives in the Zone-1 anode this part mates to,
cem/anchor_zone1.*.json)
8. Inspect: SEM of the catalytic face BEFORE shipment (01_02 1.5, factory obligation): x5,000 for micro-roughness (report the AREAL Sa of the 01_02 1.2
acceptance row, not a profile Ra) and x50,000 for nano-pores Sv - if nano-pores are not visible at x50,000 the etch is insufficient and EAAE (01_02 1.3
Step 4) is repeated; the x500 frame of 01_02 1.5 is for gyroid macro-pores and has no subject on this part. Bus channel: MACHINED after printing to the
tolerance block (primary datum, 0.05 concentricity/runout) and it must accept the 0.15 mm structural liner (01_01 1.4) - an as-printed bore fails this
part. Its own diametral band is listed as bore_dia with BOTH limits NOT SPECIFIED: that blank is the open vendor question of 00_07 HW.34, not a licence
to accept any bore that passes concentricity. PEP is confined to the outer jacket: measure Ra <= 0.4 um THERE and nowhere else, because PEP on the
catalytic face would cut away exactly the ECSA Step 4 just created (01_02 1.3 Step 7). Selective Hard-Gold ENIG on the central GND pad and outer pogo
ring only (02_02 1.2); the PEEK isolation ring that clause wants left bare between them is NOT in this geometry (solid Ti top face; open, 00_07 HW.34),
so there is no bare ring to inspect until it is. ATTENTION: the batch-level SEM ACCEPTANCE CRITERION - what morphology passes, as opposed to which
frames to shoot - does not exist in canon yet and is an open leg (00_07 HW.1); do not read its absence as a pass. ANODE-TO-CATHODE RESISTANCE, added
2026-09-12: measure it on the ASSEMBLED anchor before shipment. The bus rod runs up this channel isolated by a 0.15 mm PEEK liner, and a missing or
wear-through liner shorts anode to cathode (~0.5 V) - that is a NODE failure, not a degradation, and no direct control on a missing tube exists
otherwise (00_07 HW.34, FMEA row #22 carries D=8 for exactly this reason). Cheapest mitigation in the whole register and it belongs on THIS part's
acceptance sheet, because the channel is here. O-RING GROOVE (top face): measure the depth 1.344 against the tolerance you quoted (post-process) and the
FLATNESS of the top face across the seal land r 7.785-10.7 - the radome rim lands there as the seal datum and both faces share one +/-98 um chain (00_07
HW.33); o_ring_groove_depth is listed with BOTH limits NOT SPECIFIED on purpose, that blank is the open shop question, not a licence
9. Central GND pad O4-5 (Hard Gold ENIG >=0.76 um Au / 1.27 um Ni) — galvanic-trap fix (02_02 1.2)
10. 02_02 1.2 requires a PEEK isolation ring >=1.5 mm centre<->outer (short-circuit guard); this geometry does NOT provide it - the top face is solid Ti to
the bore edge (open, 00_07 HW.34)
11. Shank O9 + thickness 3 = HW.8 placeholders — this drawing forces the reconcile
12. Cathode catalytic = side/perimeter (Laccase/ZIF + PTFE-GDL); pogo = top face
13. O-ring groove on the top face = the capsule's SINGLE seal (02_02 3.2, 00_07 HW.33 branch (a), applied 2026-09-14); the radome rim is FLAT and closes
it. The bayonet lugs still sit at mid-disc: the raised collar the Z-reconcile ratified (02_02 4.4) is not in this geometry - its wall is set by nothing
yet
TOLERANCES / GD&T:
Fit: H7/s6 (canon's nominal class only - and the class itself is open: the tree's only band, 5-34 um, is an H7/r6 read, 00_07 HW.3)
shank_dia: NOT SPECIFIED IN CEM / NOT SPECIFIED IN CEM mm
bore_dia: NOT SPECIFIED IN CEM / NOT SPECIFIED IN CEM mm
o_ring_groove_depth: NOT SPECIFIED IN CEM / NOT SPECIFIED IN CEM mm
Datum A: bore axis
Datum B: flange face
Concentricity: ⌀0.05 (A)
Runout: 0.05 (A)
